description: Josephine County deserves leaders who can disagree without sacrificing dignity, respect, or decency. As this campaign has unfolded, I've found myself reflecting on the increasingly personal nature of political disagreements and what that means for our community. I believe we can stand firmly behind our values, hold one another accountable, and have difficult conversations without tearing people down. Because how we treat one another matters, and Josephine County deserves leadership that reflects that.
title: Does Dignity Still Matter? - Susan for Josephine
